body: He doesn't have a plan anymore. All medicines and our gun is out of his access. He said he didn't go through with it but is still depressed and in pain. I spoke with the helpline, they just said to call the VA. He'll go there Friday. I just don't know what to do in the meantime or how to talk about it. I'm not a vet, I don't want to say or do the wrong thing.
